title: Migrating from Cognos and other BI tools
summary: Concept map from IBM Cognos to Power BI and a general pattern for other legacy BI tools, with coexistence and vendor-claim cautions.

title: Migrating Excel workbooks to Power BI
summary: How to move Excel data, Power Query queries and Power Pivot models into Power BI, and what changed for uploaded local workbooks.

title: BI migration checklist
summary: A stage-by-stage checklist for moving from any legacy BI tool to Power BI, covering inventory, model, security, licensing, validation and cutover.

title: Migrating to Power BI: process and stages
summary: Summarizes Microsoft's five-stage approach to migrating from a third-party BI tool to Power BI, with success practices and a rebuild-not-convert principle.

title: Migrating from Qlik to Power BI
summary: Maps QlikView and Qlik Sense concepts such as associative model, load scripts and set analysis to Power BI equivalents, with pitfalls.

title: Migrating SSRS and RDL reports to Power BI
summary: Official tools and steps to move SSRS paginated reports (RDL) to Power BI, and to migrate a report server to Power BI Report Server.

title: Migrating from Tableau to Power BI
summary: Concept mapping from Tableau to Power BI, covering LOD expressions, parameters, extracts, Prep and common pitfalls, with source tiers labeled.
